title: Fix: Sol S1/S2 on PR #634 (Sonnet 5.5)
description:
Fix the MATERIAL finding S1 (and the non-material S2 page nit) from the Sol review of PR #634 (read in full: `bd show eshyra-b0hg.2`). Branch from origin/eshyra-b0hg. Deps installed. Edit only packages/core/src/character/skillBonuses.ts and its test (and contextAssembler test if the render assertion lives there). Do not touch levelUpSpells.ts / finalizeCharacter.ts (parallel task).
S1: the Jack of All Trades / Remarkable Athlete context notes must be gated on whether the character HOLDS the feature (class/subclass + level, sharing the gating used by the derivation), not on whether some named skill consumed the bonus. Per-skill arithmetic and resolve_check contract unchanged. S2: fix the SRD page citation p.11 -> p.12 for Jack of All Trades.
EVIDENCE: a generalized rendering invariant varying proficiency coverage and feature level: a level-7 Champion proficient in Athletics, Acrobatics, Stealth, Sleight of Hand still gets the Remarkable Athlete note; level 6 does not; a bard 2 proficient in every skill still gets the Jack of All Trades note. Confirm the new test fails on the pre-fix code (copy files aside; never git stash).
PROTOCOL: npm run verify:worktree BEFORE commit; commit (Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>); bd update <your-bead> --append-notes; bd close <your-bead>. No push/PR.
notes: Commit c0d6e1f165d44259f1e32cc49061e383b9d56e97. renderSkillsLine notes now gated by shared holdsJackOfAllTrades/holdsRemarkableAthlete (also used by derivation); p.11->p.12. Tests: parameterized Champion L7/L6 coverage + bard-all-skills; 2 failed pre-fix (verified by restoring old source), pass post-fix. verify:worktree green (6319 passed).
